mapper.select: insert into learning_sessions ( user_id, session_type, session_source, total_steps ) values ( cast(#{userId} as uuid), #{sessionType}, #{sessionSource}, #{totalSteps} ) returning id::text

select li.id::text as learning_item_id from series_subscriptions ss join series s on s.id = ss.series_id join packs p on p.series_id = s.id and p.is_published = true join learning_items li on li.pack_id = p.id and li.is_published = true where ss.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and ss.status = 'active' and s.is_published = true and (#{seriesId} is null or s.id = cast(#{seriesId} as uuid)) and not exists ( select 1 from excluded_learning_items ex where ex.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and ex.learning_item_id = li.id ) and not exists ( select 1 from user_answers ua where ua.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and ua.learning_item_id = li.id and coalesce(ua.is_correct, false) = true ) order by s.created_at asc, p.order_index asc, li.order_index asc limit #{limit}

select rs.learning_item_id::text as learning_item_id from review_schedules rs where rs.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and rs.next_review_at is not null and rs.next_review_at < #{dueBefore} and not exists ( select 1 from excluded_learning_items ex where ex.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and ex.learning_item_id = rs.learning_item_id ) order by rs.next_review_at asc

select f.learning_item_id::text as learning_item_id from favorites f where f.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and (#{itemId} is null or f.learning_item_id = cast(#{itemId} as uuid)) and not exists ( select 1 from excluded_learning_items ex where ex.user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) and ex.learning_item_id = f.learning_item_id ) order by f.created_at desc

select id::text as id, user_id::text as user_id, session_type, session_source, status, total_steps, completed_steps, completed_at from learning_sessions where id = cast(#{sessionId} as uuid) and user_id = cast(#{userId} as uuid) limit 1

select lsi.id::text as session_item_id, li.id::text as learning_item_id, li.source_text, li.target_text, li.nuance_note, li.example_sentence, li.example_translation, lsi.answer_checked, lsi.last_answer_correct from learning_session_items lsi join learning_items li on li.id = lsi.learning_item_id where lsi.session_id = cast(#{sessionId} as uuid) and lsi.queue_status = 'pending' order by lsi.sequence_no asc limit 1
select count(*) from learning_session_items where session_id = cast(#{sessionId} as uuid) and queue_status = 'pending'
select coalesce(max(sequence_no), 0) from learning_session_items where session_id = cast(#{sessionId} as uuid)
mapper.update: update learning_session_items set answer_checked = true, last_answer_correct = #{isCorrect}, updated_at = now() where id = cast(#{sessionItemId} as uuid)

update learning_session_items set sequence_no = #{sequenceNo}, queue_bucket = 'retry', answer_checked = false, last_rating = #{lastRating}, retry_count = retry_count + 1, updated_at = now() where id = cast(#{sessionItemId} as uuid)
update learning_session_items set queue_status = #{queueStatus}, last_rating = #{lastRating}, updated_at = now() where id = cast(#{sessionItemId} as uuid)
update learning_sessions set total_steps = total_steps + #{totalStepsDelta}, completed_steps = completed_steps + #{completedStepsDelta}, updated_at = now() where id = cast(#{sessionId} as uuid)
update learning_sessions set status = 'completed', completed_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = cast(#{sessionId} as uuid)
mapper.select: select count(*) from learning_session_items where session_id = cast(#{sessionId} as uuid) and queue_status = #{queueStatus}
